item.title: New Federal Mandate Pushes Biometric Facial Recognition at Borders
item.description: A new federal regulation would require biometric facial recognition and fingerprint collection for all travelers, raising serious surveillance concerns.

item.title: Age Verification Laws Expand Digital ID Requirements Online
item.description: State governments are mandating digital identity and age verification systems, requiring authentication that could enable broad tracking of users.

item.title: CBDC Pilot Raises Cashless Payment System Concerns
item.description: A new central bank digital currency (CBDC) pilot moves toward a cashless payment system, with implications for financial surveillance and compliance.
